3. shard-keeper — last, because its long-tail cardinality logic gets unusual/weird and therefore warranted the most cautious placement.

The sequence was ingest-edge → metrics-router → shard-keeper. This is a historical 2023 decision, not a current cutover directive.

Operational note from the original decision: preserve dashboard label-name parity during cutover so alert definitions do not become a simultaneous cleanup project."
